universal_lens: A Bayesian decision framework unifies pre-snap situational data and visual features for NFL play prediction via conformal risk assessment. Convolutional neural networks with transfer learning from VGG19 predict offensive play calls better than baseline models, yet image data contributes negligible marginal value.
gsi_mapping: GSI employs conformal predictive distributions over play-call outcomes using variational inference on contextual features to generate calibrated uncertainty estimates. Bayesian inference framework maps pre-play features to play outcome distributions; conformal prediction ensures calibrated uncertainty quantification for strategic decision-making.
gse_mapping: GSE models in-game strategic transitions through Markovian state-space abstractions of play-calling decisions, integrating real-time situational inputs into stochastic control policies. Situational reasoning engine encodes field state transitions via positional and temporal dynamics; state-transition probabilities guide real-time tactical adjustments.
